bio: Located in the heart of the village, close to Claude Monet's house and the Musée des Impressionnismes Giverny, La Musardière serves a bistronomy lunch menu at Le M and more ambitious dining options in the evening at Révélations. The convivial, contemporary bistro setting is complemented by a pleasant terrace that receives plenty of sun in summer. A number of guestrooms are available, should you wish to extend your stay....
